message.content: Good morning. I have the draft for the heritage society meeting minutes here, but I’m not sure about the wording for the last paragraph. The treasurer mentioned the grant application was 'pending' but I want to be more precise. Can you help me phrase it so it sounds professional but clear that we are just waiting for the official letter?

content.text: Good morning, Krzysztof. I can certainly help with that. To ensure the tone is appropriate for your records, would you like to emphasize that the submission is complete and under review, or simply state that the outcome is awaited? Here is a neutral option: 'The grant application has been formally submitted and is currently under review by the relevant authorities.' Does that work for you?

message.content: Yes, that is good. It is clear. Now, regarding the pension paperwork I showed you last week—the one about the disability supplement. I think I have the missing form now. It is the ZUS ZS declaration. Can you tell me again which box I need to fill in to declare my current income status?

content.text: Of course. For the ZUS ZS form, if you are declaring your current income status for the disability supplement, you generally need to complete section B, specifically box 10, where you indicate the type of income and the period it covers. Since you are retired, ensure you select the option for retirement pension income. Would you like me to send you a checklist of the required attachments for this specific submission?

message.content: No, I have the list. I just needed to confirm the box. Thank you. I will print it out and take it to the post office tomorrow. The garden is looking good today, the tomatoes are starting to set.

content.text: That is wonderful to hear. Enjoy the rest of your day, Krzysztof. Please let me know if you have any questions after you fill out the form.
